title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: A near-D4d arrangement of eight oxygen donors in a distorted square antiprism can enhance Dy(III) magnetic anisotropy under the crystal field.
explanation: Jiang's neutral [Dy(acac)3(H2O)2] is presented as the starting acac SMM: local symmetry close to D4d, with eight coordinated O atoms in a deformed tetragonal antiprism that strengthens Dy3+ anisotropy.
scope: Eight-coordinate mononuclear Dy-acac-type complexes of this geometry.
conditions: Two water ligands complete the O8 coordination sphere in the cited complex.
caveats: This is one founding example; later fluorinated analogues in the same subsection show that ligand substitution can shift the barrier (87 K to 122 K) without preserving an identical structure.
